item.title: Medtronic Notifies Customers After ShinyHunters Breach Exposes Personal and Health Data
item.content:encoded:
Medtronic notifies customers impacted by ShinyHunters data breach — Must Read

Medtronic is notifying customers after ShinyHunters accessed corporate IT systems and exposed personal and health-related data, potentially including names, contact details, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, and health information. The company says its medical devices were not affected and that the stolen data has not been posted online.

  • Medtronic is notifying affected customers about a data breach that exposed personal data to an unauthorized third party.
  • Medtronic said it detected unusual activity on certain corporate IT systems on April 15, 2026, and an investigation found unauthorized access from April 13 to April 19, 2026.
  • The exposed data may include full names, contact information, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, and health-related information.
  • The ShinyHunters group claimed it held 9 million Medtronic records and listed Medtronic on its dark web extortion portal on April 18 before later removing the entry.
  • Medtronic said the stolen data was not exposed online and that its medical devices remain safe to use and were not affected by the incident.
